definitions.explanation: Natural variation between individual organisms, products, or specimens of the same type. Used for biological, medical, and product quality contexts.

examples.japanese: {個体差|こたいさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

examples.english: There are individual differences in how well medicine works.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天然素材|てんねんそざい}→天然素材：25173_tennensozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧や⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{個体差|こたいさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧でご⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: As this is made from natural materials, please understand that there may be individual differences in color and pattern.

notes:
Compound noun: ⟦{個体|こたい}→個体：04028_kotai⟧ (individual organism/specimen) + ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (difference). Commonly seen in product disclaimers for natural or handmade items, and in medical contexts regarding drug efficacy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個体差|こたいさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is individual variation)
- {個体差|こたいさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ (large individual variation)
- {個体差|こたいさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考慮|こうりょ}する→考慮する：06061_kouryosuru⟧ (to take individual differences into account)
